summary.title: Invoice for Prince Upgrades & Support
summary.long_summary: This document is an invoice issued by YesLogic Pty. Ltd., located at 7 / 39 Bouverie St, Carlton VIC 3053, Australia. The invoice was dated November 26, 2016, with the invoice number 161126. Payment is due 30 days after the invoice date. The invoice itemizes a single service: Prince Upgrades & Support, covering the period from November 26, 2016 to November 26, 2017, for a total amount of USD $950.00. The total payable amount is USD $950.00. Payment instructions specify that the amount should be transferred to Yes Logic Pty Ltd via Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA). The bank details include the account name, bank name, multiple BSB numbers (063010 and 063019), account number 13201652, SWIFT code CTBAAU2S, and the bank address at 231 Swanston St, Melbourne, VIC 3000, Australia. A note explains that Australian banks use BSB numbers instead of IBANs when transferring funds. The invoice also references the company website www.yeslogic.com for additional information.
